recentItems.title: Lindsay Clancy's Ex-Husband Patrick Clancy Speaks Out on Mistrial | E! News
recentItems.description:
Lindsay Clancy’s ex-husband Patrick Clancy shared his thoughts on the end of her murder trial. After Judge William F. Sullivan declared a mistrial on Sept. 4—with the jury unable to determine if the former nurse was criminally responsible for the deaths of her three young kids—Patrick’s attorney David Meier released a statement on behalf of his client, thanking the judicial system for the time spent on the case. "Patrick Clancy is grateful to the Court and to the jurors for their hard work, their commitment, and their perseverance,” Meier said in a statement, per WBZ reporter Kristina Rex. “The loss of Patrick's children is something from which he will never recover and from which there will never be closure.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435771/lindsay-clancy-murder-trial-patrick-clancy-speaks-out-after-mistrial

recentItems.title: Kim Zolciak’s Son KJ's Sexual Assault Case: Lawyer Explains Indictment | E! News
recentItems.description:
Kroy "KJ" Biermann Jr.'s lawyer says the legal process has only begun. After Kim Zolciak and Kroy Biermann's son was indicted on seven counts related to sexual assault on Sept. 3, including sexual battery against a child under 16 and false imprisonment, his attorney Jason Sheffield has responded by stating that the case moving forward will allow his client's innocence to be proven. "An arrest and an indictment cannot tell us the whole truth of a case because, at those stages, the magistrate judge and the grand jury have heard only one side,” Sheffield proclaimed. “The evidence that I have gathered will prove, at the appropriate time and place, that KJ Biermann is not guilty of these horrific allegations." Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435775/kim-zolciaks-son-kj-sexual-assault-case-lawyer-explains-indictment

recentItems.title: Survivor Contestant Stavros Floros' Leg Severed, Sues for $100 Million | E! News
recentItems.description:
Stavros Floros is seeking compensation after suffering a gruesome injury. Nearly four months after the Survivor Greece contestant lost his leg in a boat accident during the show’s production, he sued the show for $100 million, claiming conditions of filming led to his injuries, according to the lawsuit obtained by E! News Sept. 3. While spearfishing in the ocean near the Dominican Republic, Floros’ legs were struck by the propellers of a tourist boat, causing grave injury to his right leg and resulting in the loss of his left leg, per the filing. The 22-year-old argues in his lawsuit that the producers were negligent and did not do their due diligence in establishing safety protocols to keep contestants and tourist boats separate. Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435741/survivor-greece-contestant-sues-for-s100m-after-leg-severed-on-show

recentItems.title: Phaedra Parks Confirms CT Tamburello Romance 2 Years After Traitors | E! News
recentItems.description:
RHOA's Phaedra Parks confirmed she's dating The Challenge's CT Tamburello following the Traitors costars' memorable relationship that began on season two of the Peacock show in 2023. When addressing whether their connection was platonic on Jeff Lewis Live Sept. 4, Parks said, "No, it's not."  As such, the attorney added that the reality stars had some exciting date nights on the books. "We're going to the Emmys," Parks explained, referring to the Creative Emmy Awards Sept. 5. "He's a presenter, so I'm his date." The 52-year-old added that Tamburello, 46, is set to accompany her on a work trip on Fire Island in New York after the ceremony. But their cross-country romance, with Parks living in Atlanta while the Boston personality resides elsewhere on the East Coast, commenced during Parks' last visit to Hollywood. Parks was previously married to Apollo Nida—with whom she shares kids Ayden, 16, and Dylan, 13—from 2009 to 2017. Tamburello shares son CJ Tamburello Jr., 10, with ex-wife Lilianet Solares and went on to marry Catalina White in 2024, though they split in January. Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435767/phaedra-parks-ct-tamburello-dating-after-traitors-relationship-confirmed

recentItems.title: Bunnie Xo Shares How Cameron Diaz Inspired Her Baby Plans | E! News
recentItems.description:
Bunnie Xo revealed that Cameron Diaz has helped her feel more confident about having a child at the age of 46 after she and ex-husband Jelly Roll experienced a difficult fertility journey. “You know who inspired me a lot more too is freaking Cameron Diaz,” Bunnie exclaimed to host Jenna Bush Hager on the Sept. 3 episode of the Open Book podcast. “She just had her third child at like 53!” Indeed, Diaz—now 54—and husband Benji Madden, 47, announced the birth of their son Nautas in May, with the tiny tot joining sister Raddix, 6, and brother Cardinal, 2. “I think that’s so inspiring, and I feel like it gives you a purpose later on in life to live for,” Bunnie explained. “So yeah—I will still have a baby.” However, the podcaster (real name Alisa DeFord)—stepmom to Jelly Roll’s kids Bailee Ann, 18, and Noah, 10—admitted she likely wouldn’t be as open about her IVF journey this time around. Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435766/jelly-rolls-ex-bunnie-xo-shares-how-cameron-diaz-inspired-her-baby-plans
